messages:
maria: Heads-up: we need 8 GPU nodes backfilled into staging for the extended canary tests starting next week. Who's owning procurement follow-up and reservation reassign? Need ETA by EOD.

jonathan: I can take procurement. Current vendor (LTX) pushed H100 ship ETA to Jun 12 due to customs. We have 4 units available earlier from vendor B (Jun 6) but different SKU (A100->H100 trade).

sasha: Platform: we have 6 reserved slots in 'staging-pool-east' that are currently idle. Can we reassign 4 to staging? Who owns the reservation change? Also note SKU mismatch might impact runtime config.

kevin: Runtime: if we swap A100 for H100 need to update qconfig and kernel flags. Will need a short validation job. Proposed window: Jun 7 01:00-03:00 UTC. Ping me PR early.

infra-bot: shipment-bot: LTX shipment 54421 delayed -> estimated arrival 2024-06-12. Tracking: https://carrier/track/54421

maria: Thanks. Jonathan, please confirm if vendor B quote includes rack & racking. Sasha, can you check if the 6 reserved slots are free to reassign? If not, what's the blocker?

jonathan: Vendor B includes racking + 1yr NBD support. Quote attached (s3 link). I'm putting in PO today if you want faster path. :thumbsup:

sasha: Checked: 4 of the 6 slots are tied to sandbox projects (auto-scale off). I can free them by removing the 'reserve' tag; need @product-scheduling sign-off to move capacity between pools. Filing request in #eng-platform-ops.

anya: I'm on PR review for the kernel/qconfig changes — left comments on draft. Small nit: need to update the batching heuristic when GPU type changes. Example snippet I left: `if gpu_type == 'H100': batch_size *= 1.2`

kevin: Noted @anya, I'll push update tonight. Can we also run perf smoke: `./bench --profile --nodes 1 --model llama-3`

maria: Plan summary: Jonathan to confirm PO by EOD (fast path). Sasha to request reserve tag removal (platform ops). Kevin/Anya to prep runtime changes + perf smoke in Jun 7 window. I'll coordinate canary schedule with QA. If vendor B goes through we'll backfill by Jun 6-7. If not, fallback to staged reservation changes by Jun 12.

sasha: Added request: ENGOPS ticket #4521. Tagging @product-scheduling and @finance to approve move. :eyes:

jonathan: PO submitted to vendor B (pending invoice). I'll post invoice + lead time when available.

maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll update the deck and ping PMs. :v:
